    4. 
      

      

        A small motion language
        

          scene, text and shape create
          clips. Text supports
          .place("left" | "center" | "bottom"); motion supports
          "rise", "fade", "orbit",
          "pulse" or "none". Scenes support
          .look("orbit" | "pulse" | "grid"). Times are in seconds.
        

        

          This is an interaction prototype with procedural graphics. Media
          import, audio and video export are outside this demo.
